profiles.name: local-test-example
notes: This is a disabled example profile.
Replace paths with local machine paths before enabling.
Prefer workbench.bat profile init; machine-local profiles are stored outside the Workbench under PVF-Agent-Workbench-State.
Use one profile per test client; client-pvf deployment still requires a separate preview and confirmation.
Do not bind a redistributable package to machine-local development paths.
